brief: Holds a list of Unicode code points and turns it into characters, text and per-script checks.
detail: Reach for it when you hold numbers such as 1513 and want the text, or hold a text's code points and want to ask whether they are all letters, digits, symbols or in one script. It is built with StzStringUnicodeListQ(aList); stzString does not hand one out. The list is validated at birth: every item must be a number from 0 to 1114111. The AllAre... checks build the text of the code points and ask the engine, so one check on a long list costs a string build; they answer FALSE for an empty list. Sorted, Unique and Reversed return new lists and never change the one held.
